avis.titre: First Impressions: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Balm
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. First impressions: It's thick & does not absorb instantly. My hands took a little time to absorb in, but once they did, they felt very moisturized and soft. I noticed one of the ingredients is dimethicone. This ingredient is used to temporary relieve chapped skin. So with that being noted, I feel like this could go well with another skin care product. For instance, if you use a topical steroid for eczema, this may be a good addition to add with that. I feel like it is effective and so far it has helped to keep my hands from getting dry. I also have anxiety/adhd and pick at my skin on my thumb quite often. This has helped them from becoming dry and kept that area very moisturized.
